description:
From the most beloved virtual friends franchise of all time comes a new and wonderful journey for all the adventurers out there. Welcome to Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom! 

Join our adorable hero Mametchi as he travels far and wide across the world to solve problems, make friends, and use the power of happiness to restore the kingdom. Build and decorate your wilderness camp and invite your most loyal Tamagotchi companions to have fun together. 


EMBARK ON AN EPIC AND WHOLESOME ADVENTURE 

Your adventure begins on a night of stargazing when a mysterious impact shakes the Tamagotchi planet creating a series of strange events all over the kingdom.  

Mametchi and his friends need your help to bring back harmony! Use your party’s special abilities to overcome obstacles, find hidden treasures and come to the rescue of fellow citizens to harness the power of happiness. 


EXPLORE THE QUIRKY WORLD OF TAMAGOTCHI 

From the Patchi Forest and its funny-looking hot springs to the Guru Guru Park orchestrated by giant Tamagotchi characters – each place is a fantasy of its own!  

Complete hundreds of kind-hearted quests to unlock new areas full of love and surprises. Walk, drive or swim, this world is yours to uncover! 


MEET AND BEFRIEND ADORABLE TAMAGOTCHI FRIENDS 

In the unique world of Tamagotchi, everything is alive, and every living is a selfless and benevolent Tama-friends you can interact with. 

Reunite with old Tamagotchi companions and make new friends! There are nearly 300 Tamagotchi characters to encounter. Each with their own quirky personality! 
 

MAKE IT YOUR OWN TAMAGOTCHI KINGDOM 

Your camp is your own little kingdom, make it as nice and cozy as it can be to welcome your Tama-buddies. 

Decorate your home with gorgeous furniture and venture in style with special outfits for your party characters. Mametchi wearing vintage 3D Glasses is a must-see! 

 
Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom is a game full of delights and surprises for kids and grown-ups to discover. More content will be added regularly so start your adventure now and enjoy the Tamagotchi ride!
